svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two; the same block as FieldNode's (FND-DWG-102). Saw a 20 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: slice off 60 x 40 mm bar; saw and file to 60 wide x 33 deep x 20 tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The flat back goes on the bracket plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Scribe a 90 degree V on both 60 x 33 faces with a 45 degree square:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 50.4 mm wide at the front face, point 7.8 mm from the back face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw just inside the lines, file to them; keep the V faces flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Break the V's front edges 0.5 mm so they cannot score the pole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 3.3 mm 14 deep and tap M4 12 deep in the back face, at 18 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each side of centre, half way up (10 mm).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: two M4 countersunk screws from the front of the plate. The 60 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pole touches both V faces 29 mm from the plate; 40 to 71 mm poles seat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: on a 60 mm tube the block must not rock.
